knowledge.name: Unit 1 What can you do with your five senses?
五官与感官动词的配对
knowledge.parent: Unit 1 What can you do with your five senses?
knowledge.explanation: eyes 配 see、ears 配 hear、nose 配 smell、tongue 配 taste、hands 配 touch；问 What can you do with your eyes? 用 I can see 回答。

knowledge.name: What can you do? I can... 问答句型
knowledge.parent: Unit 1 What can you do with your five senses?
knowledge.explanation: 问 What can you do? 用 I can + 感官动词回答；Can you hear the bell? 的简答是 Yes, I can. / No, I can't.，can 后加 not 表否定。

knowledge.name: 感官形容词与名词搭配
knowledge.parent: Unit 1 What can you do with your five senses?
knowledge.explanation: sweet 配 candy、sour 配 lemon、soft 配 pillow、hard 配 stone、loud 配 drum；用 It is + 形容词 或 It tastes... 描述，味道与触感声音不能混用。

knowledge.name: 字母 Ss 发 /s/ 的首音辨识
knowledge.parent: Unit 1 What can you do with your five senses?
knowledge.explanation: 字母 Ss 在 see、sun、sit、sea、sing 词首发 /s/；把首音相同的词归一类，与元音或别的辅音起首的词区分。

knowledge.name: Unit 2 What do you like about your family?
家庭成员称呼词的辨认
knowledge.parent: Unit 2 What do you like about your family?
knowledge.explanation: father 与 mother 合称 parents，grandpa/grandma 是祖辈，uncle/aunt/cousin 是叔姨与堂表亲，brother/sister 是亲兄弟姐妹，按辈分与性别区分。

knowledge.name: Who is he/she? He/She is... 问答
knowledge.parent: Unit 2 What do you like about your family?
knowledge.explanation: 问 Who is he? 用 He is my + 男性称呼；问 Who is she? 用 She is my + 女性称呼。he 指男、she 指女、it 指物、they 指复数，不能混用。

knowledge.name: 描述家人的形容词与 My... is...
knowledge.parent: Unit 2 What do you like about your family?
knowledge.explanation: kind 善良、tall 高、young 年轻、busy 忙、short 矮；形容词放 be 动词后作表语，如 My grandma is kind.，tall 与 short、young 与 old 互为反义。

knowledge.name: 字母 Ff 与 /f/ 的对应
knowledge.parent: Unit 2 What do you like about your family?
knowledge.explanation: Ff 在 father、family、fish、four、face、five 词首发 /f/，上齿轻碰下唇送气；与元音起首或别的辅音起首的词区分。

knowledge.name: Unit 3 What is your favourite toy?
玩具名词的辨认
knowledge.parent: Unit 3 What is your favourite toy?
knowledge.explanation: ball 可拍、kite 靠风飞、doll 与 teddy bear 用来抱、robot 会走会说、train 在地上跑、blocks 可搭；按玩法区分不同玩具。

knowledge.name: What is your favourite toy? 问答
knowledge.parent: Unit 3 What is your favourite toy?
knowledge.explanation: favourite 意为最喜欢的；问 What is your favourite toy? 答 My favourite toy is a... 或直接说玩具名，简答可用 I like... best。

knowledge.name: 颜色词与 It is + colour 描述
knowledge.parent: Unit 3 What is your favourite toy?
knowledge.explanation: red 红、blue 蓝、green 绿、yellow 黄；问 What colour is it? 答 It is red.，形容词放名词前说 a red ball，不能说 a ball red。

knowledge.name: 字母 Bb 发 /b/ 的首音辨识
knowledge.parent: Unit 3 What is your favourite toy?
knowledge.explanation: Bb 在 ball、bear、bike、book、blue、bus 词首发 /b/，双唇闭合再放开、声带振动；与 /p/ 的清音相对，按首音给词归类。

knowledge.name: Unit 4 What is around your home?
家周边场所名词
knowledge.parent: Unit 4 What is around your home?
knowledge.explanation: park 玩耍、shop 买东西、school 上课、library 安静读书、zoo 看动物、playground 运动、hospital 看病；按功能辨认不同场所。

knowledge.name: There is / There are 句型
knowledge.parent: Unit 4 What is around your home?
knowledge.explanation: 介绍附近有什么用 There be：单数 a park 配 There is，复数 two shops 配 There are；is 与 are 随后面名词的单复数变化，不用 am 或 be。

knowledge.name: 方位介词 near / next to / behind
knowledge.parent: Unit 4 What is around your home?
knowledge.explanation: near 在附近、next to 紧挨着、behind 在后面、in front of 在前面、far 远；问 Where is the shop? 用 It's next to the park. 回答。

knowledge.name: 字母 Pp 发 /p/ 的首音辨识
knowledge.parent: Unit 4 What is around your home?
knowledge.explanation: Pp 在 park、pencil、play、purple、pink、pen 词首发 /p/，双唇送气、声带不振动；与 /b/ 的浊音相对，按首音归类。

knowledge.name: Unit 5 What do you like about farms?
农场动物名词
knowledge.parent: Unit 5 What do you like about farms?
knowledge.explanation: cow 产奶、hen 下蛋、duck 会游、sheep 产毛、horse 能骑、goat 与 pig 也养在农场；按外形与产物区分，sheep 是羊不是鸟。

knowledge.name: 动物叫声拟声词
knowledge.parent: Unit 5 What do you like about farms?
knowledge.explanation: cow 叫 moo、duck 叫 quack、hen 叫 cluck、sheep 叫 baa、horse 叫 neigh、pig 叫 oink；句型 The cow says "moo." 把动物与声音配对。

knowledge.name: How many...? There are... 数词问答
knowledge.parent: Unit 5 What do you like about farms?
knowledge.explanation: 问 How many cows? 答 There are + 数词 + 复数名词；one 后接单数，two 起接复数并加 -s，如 three ducks、one cow。

knowledge.name: 字母 Dd 发 /d/ 的首音辨识
knowledge.parent: Unit 5 What do you like about farms?
knowledge.explanation: Dd 在 duck、dog、desk、door、dig 词首发 /d/，舌尖抵上齿龈、声带振动；与 /t/ 的清音相对，把首音相同的词归一类。

knowledge.name: Unit 6 How do people celebrate the Mid-Autumn Festival?
中秋节名词
knowledge.parent: Unit 6 How do people celebrate the Mid-Autumn Festival?
knowledge.explanation: Mid-Autumn Festival 是中秋节，moon 月亮、mooncake 月饼、lantern 灯笼、story 故事、night 夜晚；mooncake 用来吃、lantern 用来提、moon 用来赏。

knowledge.name: We eat... / We look at... 庆祝句型
knowledge.parent: Unit 6 How do people celebrate the Mid-Autumn Festival?
knowledge.explanation: 用 We + 动词 说一起做的事：We eat mooncakes. We look at the moon. We carry lanterns.；主语 We 是复数，动词不加 s，look at 是固定搭配。

knowledge.name: round / bright / full 描述月亮
knowledge.parent: Unit 6 How do people celebrate the Mid-Autumn Festival?
knowledge.explanation: round 圆、bright 亮、full 满、dim 暗、square 方、long 长、small 小；The moon is round and bright.，形容词放 be 后或名词前说 a round mooncake。

knowledge.name: 字母 Mm 发 /m/ 的首音辨识
knowledge.parent: Unit 6 How do people celebrate the Mid-Autumn Festival?
knowledge.explanation: Mm 在 moon、mooncake、mouth、map、mango 词首发 /m/，双唇闭合、气流从鼻出；与别的首音区分，按首音给词归类。

chapters.name: Unit 1 What can you do with your five senses?
chapters.summary: 学习五官与 see/hear/smell/taste/touch 五个感官动词，用 I can... 描述感受，用 sweet/soft 等词搭配，并辨识字母 Ss 的 /s/ 首音。

questions.stem: What can you do with your eyes?
questions.analysis: 眼睛 eyes 用来看 flower；另三项用耳、鼻、舌，所以选 A。
questions.knowledge_point: 五官与感官动词的配对

questions.stem: I ___ with my ears and ___ with my nose.
questions.analysis: 耳朵 ears 对应 hear，鼻子 nose 对应 smell，按器官填。
questions.knowledge_point: 五官与感官动词的配对

questions.stem: We taste a lemon with our hands.
questions.analysis: taste 用舌头 tongue，hands 用来摸，搭配错，所以错。
questions.knowledge_point: 五官与感官动词的配对

questions.stem: Name two sense words for your face.
questions.analysis: 评分要点：两个感官动词各得 2 分；与器官搭配合理得 1 分。
questions.knowledge_point: 五官与感官动词的配对

questions.stem: Eyes closed, what can you still do?
questions.analysis: 闭眼不能看、读、看灯，耳朵仍能听音乐，所以选 B。
questions.knowledge_point: 五官与感官动词的配对

questions.stem: What can you do with a bell?
questions.analysis: 铃会响，用耳朵 hear；其余三个动词不合铃声，所以选 A。
questions.knowledge_point: What can you do? I can... 问答句型

questions.stem: Can you see the sun? Yes, I ___.
questions.analysis: Can you...? 的肯定简答是 Yes, I can，can 不变。
questions.knowledge_point: What can you do? I can... 问答句型

questions.stem: 'No, I can.' is the right short answer.
questions.analysis: 否定简答要用 No, I can't，原句漏了 not，所以错。
questions.knowledge_point: What can you do? I can... 问答句型

questions.stem: Ask a friend about the nose in English.

answer.value: What can you do with your nose?

questions.analysis: 评分要点：用 What can you...? 提问得 2 分；提到 nose 得 2 分；语序正确得 1 分。
questions.knowledge_point: What can you do? I can... 问答句型

questions.stem: Describe a rainy day with two senses.

answer.value: I can hear the rain. I can smell the wet ground.

questions.analysis: 评分要点：两个不同感官动词各得 2 分；I can... 句型正确得 1 分。
questions.knowledge_point: What can you do? I can... 问答句型

questions.stem: How does a lemon taste?
questions.analysis: 柠檬酸用 Sour；Sweet 是糖味，Soft 与 Loud 不表味道，所以选 B。
questions.knowledge_point: 感官形容词与名词搭配

questions.stem: A pillow is ___, but a stone is ___.
questions.analysis: 枕头软 soft，石头硬 hard，两词互为反义。
questions.knowledge_point: 感官形容词与名词搭配

questions.stem: We say a drum is sweet.
questions.analysis: sweet 说味道，鼓要用 loud 说声音，搭配不当，所以错。
questions.knowledge_point: 感官形容词与名词搭配

questions.stem: Write one word for candy's taste.
questions.analysis: 评分要点：写出 sweet 得 3 分；用 It tastes... 成句再得 2 分。
questions.knowledge_point: 感官形容词与名词搭配

questions.stem: Which word starts with the /s/ sound?
questions.analysis: sun 以 s 开头发 /s/；cat、ink、up 首音不同，所以选 A。
questions.knowledge_point: 字母 Ss 发 /s/ 的首音辨识

questions.stem: Ss is for ___ and ___.
questions.analysis: Ss 读 /s/，sun 与 sit 都以它开头。
questions.knowledge_point: 字母 Ss 发 /s/ 的首音辨识

questions.stem: 'See' and 'sing' start the same.
questions.analysis: 两词词首都是 s，都发 /s/，首音相同，所以对。
questions.knowledge_point: 字母 Ss 发 /s/ 的首音辨识

questions.stem: Say two /s/ words you know.
questions.analysis: 评分要点：两个 /s/ 首音词各得 2 分；拼写正确再得 1 分。
questions.knowledge_point: 字母 Ss 发 /s/ 的首音辨识

chapters.name: Unit 2 What do you like about your family?
chapters.summary: 认读 father/mother/grandpa/uncle 等家庭成员词，用 Who is he/she? 与 He/She is... 介绍家人，用 kind/tall/young/busy 描述，学字母 Ff 的 /f/。

questions.stem: Your mother's father is your ___.
questions.analysis: 妈妈的爸爸是 grandpa；uncle 为叔舅、brother 为兄弟、cousin 为堂表，所以选 B。
questions.knowledge_point: 家庭成员称呼词的辨认

questions.stem: Father and mother are my ___.
questions.analysis: father 与 mother 合称 parents，指父母两人。
questions.knowledge_point: 家庭成员称呼词的辨认

questions.stem: A cousin is the same as a brother.
questions.analysis: cousin 是堂表亲，brother 是亲兄弟，亲疏不同，所以错。
questions.knowledge_point: 家庭成员称呼词的辨认

questions.stem: Write two words for family members.
questions.analysis: 评分要点：两个不同家庭成员词各得 2 分；拼写正确得 1 分。
questions.knowledge_point: 家庭成员称呼词的辨认

questions.stem: A man is your mum's brother. Who is he?
questions.analysis: 妈妈的兄弟是 uncle；aunt 为姨姑、grandpa 是祖辈、cousin 是同辈，所以选 A。
questions.knowledge_point: 家庭成员称呼词的辨认

questions.stem: Who is she? ___ is my grandma.
questions.analysis: grandma 是女性用 She；He 指男、It 指物、They 指复数，所以选 A。
questions.knowledge_point: Who is he/she? He/She is... 问答

questions.stem: ___ is he? He is my ___.
questions.analysis: 问人用 Who，He is my 后接男性称呼 uncle。
questions.knowledge_point: Who is he/she? He/She is... 问答

questions.stem: We say 'He is my mother'.
questions.analysis: mother 是女性，主语要用 She，he 用错，所以错。
questions.knowledge_point: Who is he/she? He/She is... 问答

questions.stem: Introduce your father in one sentence.

answer.value: He is my father. He is tall.

questions.analysis: 评分要点：用 He is my... 介绍得 2 分；加一句描述得 2 分；he 正确得 1 分。
questions.knowledge_point: Who is he/she? He/She is... 问答

questions.stem: My grandpa is not short. He is ___.
questions.analysis: not short 的反义是 tall；其余三词不说身高，所以选 A。
questions.knowledge_point: 描述家人的形容词与 My... is...

questions.stem: My sister is ___, so she cannot play.
questions.analysis: 没时间玩说明忙 busy，放 be 动词后作表语。
questions.knowledge_point: 描述家人的形容词与 My... is...

questions.stem: 'My father is young' means he is old.
questions.analysis: young 是年轻，与 old 相反，释义说反，所以错。
questions.knowledge_point: 描述家人的形容词与 My... is...

questions.stem: Write one word to describe your mum.
questions.analysis: 评分要点：写出形容人的词得 3 分；用 My mum is... 成句再得 2 分。
questions.knowledge_point: 描述家人的形容词与 My... is...

questions.stem: Ask and answer about your aunt.

answer.value: Who is she? She is my aunt. She is kind.

questions.analysis: 评分要点：Who is she? 提问得 2 分；She is my aunt 作答得 2 分；加形容词得 1 分。
questions.knowledge_point: 描述家人的形容词与 My... is...

questions.stem: Find the word with /f/ at the start.
questions.analysis: fish 以 f 开头发 /f/；owl、ant、ox 以元音起首，所以选 A。
questions.knowledge_point: 字母 Ff 与 /f/ 的对应

questions.stem: ___ and ___ begin with /f/.
questions.analysis: father 与 four 词首都发 /f/，按首音填两词。
questions.knowledge_point: 字母 Ff 与 /f/ 的对应

questions.stem: The first sound of 'family' is /f/.
questions.analysis: family 词首是 f，发 /f/，判断正确，所以对。
questions.knowledge_point: 字母 Ff 与 /f/ 的对应

questions.stem: Write two words with /f/ first.
questions.analysis: 评分要点：两个 /f/ 首音词各得 2 分；拼写正确再得 1 分。
questions.knowledge_point: 字母 Ff 与 /f/ 的对应

chapters.name: Unit 3 What is your favourite toy?
chapters.summary: 认读 ball/doll/kite/robot/teddy 等玩具词，用 What is your favourite toy? 与 My favourite toy is... 问答，用颜色词和 It is... 描述，学字母 Bb 的 /b/。

questions.stem: Which toy flies in the wind?
questions.analysis: kite 靠风飞；doll 抱、ball 拍、train 地上跑，所以选 A。
questions.knowledge_point: 玩具名词的辨认

questions.stem: A ___ can walk and talk like a person.
questions.analysis: 会走会说话的玩具是 robot，不是布娃娃。
questions.knowledge_point: 玩具名词的辨认

questions.stem: A teddy bear is not a real bear.
questions.analysis: teddy bear 是玩具熊，不是真熊，说法正确，所以对。
questions.knowledge_point: 玩具名词的辨认

questions.stem: Name two toys you can play with.
questions.analysis: 评分要点：两个不同玩具名词各得 2 分；拼写正确得 1 分。
questions.knowledge_point: 玩具名词的辨认

questions.stem: Which toy can move by itself?
questions.analysis: robot 能自己动；kite 靠风、doll 要人拿、book 不是玩具，所以选 A。
questions.knowledge_point: 玩具名词的辨认

questions.stem: What is your favourite toy?
questions.analysis: 问最爱的玩具要答玩具名 My kite；其余是问候、颜色、道谢，所以选 B。
questions.knowledge_point: What is your favourite toy? 问答

questions.stem: My ___ toy is a robot.
questions.analysis: favourite 意为最喜爱的，修饰 toy，放在 My 后。
questions.knowledge_point: What is your favourite toy? 问答

questions.stem: 'Favourite' means you like it most.
questions.analysis: favourite 就是最喜欢、排第一，释义正确，所以对。
questions.knowledge_point: What is your favourite toy? 问答

questions.stem: Ask your friend about a toy.
questions.analysis: 评分要点：用 What is your favourite...? 提问得 3 分；提到 toy 得 2 分。
questions.knowledge_point: What is your favourite toy? 问答

questions.stem: The grass is ___. What colour?
questions.analysis: 草是绿色 Green；Red、Blue、Yellow 都不符，所以选 A。
questions.knowledge_point: 颜色词与 It is + colour 描述

questions.stem: The sky is ___ and a banana is ___.
questions.analysis: 天空常是 blue，香蕉是 yellow，按常识填颜色。
questions.knowledge_point: 颜色词与 It is + colour 描述

questions.stem: We say 'a ball red' in English.
questions.analysis: 形容词要放名词前，正确是 a red ball，语序颠倒，所以错。
questions.knowledge_point: 颜色词与 It is + colour 描述

questions.stem: Write the colour of your toy.
questions.analysis: 评分要点：用 It is + 颜色成句得 3 分；颜色词拼写正确得 2 分。
questions.knowledge_point: 颜色词与 It is + colour 描述

questions.stem: Show a red ball. Say two sentences.

answer.value: This is my ball. It is red.

questions.analysis: 评分要点：This is... 介绍玩具得 2 分；It is + 颜色得 2 分；两句完整得 1 分。
questions.knowledge_point: 颜色词与 It is + colour 描述

questions.stem: Pick the word that begins with /b/.
questions.analysis: ball 以 b 开头发 /b/；jam、net、cup 首音不同，所以选 A。
questions.knowledge_point: 字母 Bb 发 /b/ 的首音辨识

questions.stem: Bb: name two words, ___ and ___.
questions.analysis: Bb 读 /b/，bear 与 bike 都以 b 开头。
questions.knowledge_point: 字母 Bb 发 /b/ 的首音辨识

questions.stem: 'Book' and 'blue' both begin with /b/.
questions.analysis: 两词词首都是 b，都发 /b/，首音相同，所以对。
questions.knowledge_point: 字母 Bb 发 /b/ 的首音辨识

questions.stem: Name two /b/ words.
questions.analysis: 评分要点：两个 /b/ 首音词各得 2 分；拼写正确再得 1 分。
questions.knowledge_point: 字母 Bb 发 /b/ 的首音辨识

chapters.name: Unit 4 What is around your home?
chapters.summary: 认读 park/shop/school/library 等家周边场所，用 There is a... near my home. 介绍，用 near/next to/behind 说位置，学字母 Pp 的 /p/。

questions.stem: Where can you read quietly?
questions.analysis: 安静读书去 library；zoo 看动物、shop 买物、park 玩，所以选 C。
questions.knowledge_point: 家周边场所名词

questions.stem: We buy bread at a ___ and play at a ___.
questions.analysis: 买东西在 shop，玩耍在 park，按功能填场所。
questions.knowledge_point: 家周边场所名词

questions.stem: A hospital is a place to see animals.
questions.analysis: 看动物去 zoo，hospital 是看病处，功能说错，所以错。
questions.knowledge_point: 家周边场所名词

questions.stem: Name two places near a home.
questions.analysis: 评分要点：两个不同场所名词各得 2 分；拼写正确得 1 分。
questions.knowledge_point: 家周边场所名词

questions.stem: ___ a park near my home.
questions.analysis: a park 单数用 There is；are 配复数，am 与 be 不用于此句型，所以选 A。
questions.knowledge_point: There is / There are 句型

questions.stem: There ___ two shops near my school.
questions.analysis: two shops 是复数，be 动词用 are，不用 is。
questions.knowledge_point: There is / There are 句型

questions.stem: 'There are a zoo' is correct.
questions.analysis: a zoo 是单数，要用 There is a zoo，are 用错，所以错。
questions.knowledge_point: There is / There are 句型

questions.stem: Tell one thing near your home.

answer.value: There is a library near my home.

questions.analysis: 评分要点：用 There is a... 句型得 3 分；场所词正确得 2 分。
questions.knowledge_point: There is / There are 句型

questions.stem: Draw your home area. Say two sentences.

answer.value: There is a park near my home. The shop is next to it.

questions.analysis: 评分要点：There is... 句型得 2 分；near 与 next to 方位得 2 分；两句连贯得 1 分。
questions.knowledge_point: There is / There are 句型

questions.stem: The shop is right ___ the school.
questions.analysis: right next to 是紧挨；behind、far、in front of 都不是，所以选 A。
questions.knowledge_point: 方位介词 near / next to / behind

questions.stem: The tree is ___ the house, not in front.
questions.analysis: not in front 提示相反方位，在后面用 behind。
questions.knowledge_point: 方位介词 near / next to / behind

questions.stem: 'Near' means very far away.
questions.analysis: near 是距离近，far 才是远，释义相反，所以错。
questions.knowledge_point: 方位介词 near / next to / behind

questions.stem: Ask where the park is.
questions.analysis: 评分要点：用 Where is...? 提问得 3 分；场所名词正确得 2 分。
questions.knowledge_point: 方位介词 near / next to / behind

questions.stem: The park is close. Which word fits?
questions.analysis: close 就是近 near；far 反义，behind、under 说方位，所以选 A。
questions.knowledge_point: 方位介词 near / next to / behind

questions.stem: Which word begins like 'park'?
questions.analysis: pencil 与 park 都发 /p/ 起首；van、web、lip 不同，所以选 A。
questions.knowledge_point: 字母 Pp 发 /p/ 的首音辨识

questions.stem: Two Pp words are ___ and ___.
questions.analysis: play 与 pink 都以 p 开头发 /p/，填同首音词。
questions.knowledge_point: 字母 Pp 发 /p/ 的首音辨识

questions.stem: You hear /p/ at the start of 'purple'.
questions.analysis: purple 词首是 p，发 /p/，判断正确，所以对。
questions.knowledge_point: 字母 Pp 发 /p/ 的首音辨识

questions.stem: Think of two /p/ words.
questions.analysis: 评分要点：两个 /p/ 首音词各得 2 分；拼写正确再得 1 分。
questions.knowledge_point: 字母 Pp 发 /p/ 的首音辨识

chapters.name: Unit 5 What do you like about farms?
chapters.summary: 认读 cow/duck/hen/sheep/horse 等农场动物与 moo/quack 叫声，用 How many...? There are... 数动物，学字母 Dd 的 /d/。

questions.stem: Which animal gives us milk?
questions.analysis: 奶牛 cow 产奶；hen 下蛋、duck 会游、horse 能骑，所以选 A。
questions.knowledge_point: 农场动物名词

questions.stem: A ___ lays eggs and a ___ says quack.
questions.analysis: 母鸡 hen 下蛋，鸭子 duck 叫 quack，按特征填。
questions.knowledge_point: 农场动物名词

questions.stem: A sheep is a farm bird.
questions.analysis: sheep 是有毛的羊，不是鸟；hen、duck 才是禽，所以错。
questions.knowledge_point: 农场动物名词

questions.stem: Name two animals on a farm.
questions.analysis: 评分要点：两个不同农场动物各得 2 分；拼写正确得 1 分。
questions.knowledge_point: 农场动物名词

questions.stem: 'Moo' comes from the farm. What is it?
questions.analysis: moo 是牛叫，说明有 cow；其余动物叫声不同，所以选 B。
questions.knowledge_point: 农场动物名词

questions.stem: What does a duck say?
questions.analysis: 鸭子叫 Quack；Moo 是牛、Baa 是羊、Neigh 是马，所以选 B。
questions.knowledge_point: 动物叫声拟声词

questions.stem: The cow says ___ and the hen says ___.
questions.analysis: 牛叫 moo、母鸡叫 cluck，按动物配拟声词。
questions.knowledge_point: 动物叫声拟声词

questions.stem: A horse says 'oink'.
questions.analysis: oink 是猪叫，马叫 neigh，搭配错误，所以错。
questions.knowledge_point: 动物叫声拟声词

questions.stem: Write the sound a sheep makes.
questions.analysis: 评分要点：写出 baa 得 3 分；用 The sheep says... 成句再得 2 分。
questions.knowledge_point: 动物叫声拟声词

questions.stem: How many legs does a hen have?
questions.analysis: 母鸡两条腿 Two；One 太少、Four 是牛马、Six 是昆虫，所以选 A。
questions.knowledge_point: How many...? There are... 数词问答

questions.stem: There are ___ ducks and ___ cow.
questions.analysis: ducks 复数填 three，cow 单数填 one，数词与单复数对应。
questions.knowledge_point: How many...? There are... 数词问答

questions.stem: We say 'two cow' in English.
questions.analysis: two 后名词加 -s，正确是 two cows，所以错。
questions.knowledge_point: How many...? There are... 数词问答

questions.stem: Ask how many pigs there are.
questions.analysis: 评分要点：用 How many...? 提问得 3 分；名词用复数再得 2 分。
questions.knowledge_point: How many...? There are... 数词问答

questions.stem: Count the animals and tell your friend.

answer.value: There are four ducks and one cow on the farm.

questions.analysis: 评分要点：There are + 数词 + 复数得 2 分；单复数一致得 2 分；成句得 1 分。
questions.knowledge_point: How many...? There are... 数词问答

questions.stem: Say these. Which one starts with /d/?
questions.analysis: duck 以 d 开头发 /d/；box、hat、key 首音不同，所以选 A。
questions.knowledge_point: 字母 Dd 发 /d/ 的首音辨识

questions.stem: ___ and ___ start with Dd.
questions.analysis: dog 与 door 词首都是 d，发 /d/。
questions.knowledge_point: 字母 Dd 发 /d/ 的首音辨识

questions.stem: 'Desk' and 'dig' share the /d/ sound.
questions.analysis: 两词词首都是 d，首音相同，判断正确，所以对。
questions.knowledge_point: 字母 Dd 发 /d/ 的首音辨识

questions.stem: Give two words that start with /d/.
questions.analysis: 评分要点：两个 /d/ 首音词各得 2 分；拼写正确再得 1 分。
questions.knowledge_point: 字母 Dd 发 /d/ 的首音辨识

chapters.name: Unit 6 How do people celebrate the Mid-Autumn Festival?
chapters.summary: 认读 moon/mooncake/lantern 等中秋词，用 We eat... / We look at... 说庆祝活动，用 round/bright/full 描述月亮，学字母 Mm 的 /m/。

questions.stem: What do people eat at this festival?
questions.analysis: 中秋吃月饼 Mooncakes；lantern 提、moon 看、story 讲，所以选 A。
questions.knowledge_point: 中秋节名词

questions.stem: We look at the ___ and carry a ___.
questions.analysis: 赏月看 moon，提灯笼 carry a lantern，按活动填词。
questions.knowledge_point: 中秋节名词

questions.stem: A lantern is a kind of cake.
questions.analysis: lantern 是提的灯笼，mooncake 才是糕点，类别错，所以错。
questions.knowledge_point: 中秋节名词

questions.stem: Name two things about this festival.
questions.analysis: 评分要点：两个不同节日事物各得 2 分；拼写正确得 1 分。
questions.knowledge_point: 中秋节名词

questions.stem: ___ eat mooncakes at night.
questions.analysis: 和同伴一起用 We；It 指物，He 与 She 是单数，所以选 A。
questions.knowledge_point: We eat... / We look at... 庆祝句型

questions.stem: We ___ at the full moon at night.
questions.analysis: look at 是固定搭配，赏月用 look at the moon。
questions.knowledge_point: We eat... / We look at... 庆祝句型

questions.stem: 'We looks at the moon' is right.
questions.analysis: 主语 We 是复数，动词用 look 不加 s，所以错。
questions.knowledge_point: We eat... / We look at... 庆祝句型

questions.stem: Say one thing you do at night.
questions.analysis: 评分要点：用 We + 动词成句得 3 分；活动与中秋相关得 2 分。
questions.knowledge_point: We eat... / We look at... 庆祝句型

questions.stem: At night we sit outside. What do we do?
questions.analysis: 中秋夜赏月 Watch the moon；moon 不能吃、cake 不用提、lantern 不是读的，所以选 A。
questions.knowledge_point: We eat... / We look at... 庆祝句型

questions.stem: The Mid-Autumn moon is ___.
questions.analysis: 中秋月是圆的 Round；Square 方、Long 长、Small 小，所以选 B。
questions.knowledge_point: round / bright / full 描述月亮

questions.stem: The moon is ___ tonight, not dim.
questions.analysis: not dim 提示反义，亮用 bright，放 be 后。
questions.knowledge_point: round / bright / full 描述月亮

questions.stem: We say 'a mooncake round'.
questions.analysis: 形容词放名词前，正确是 a round mooncake，语序错，所以错。
questions.knowledge_point: round / bright / full 描述月亮

questions.stem: Write one word for the full moon.
questions.analysis: 评分要点：写出 round 或 bright 得 3 分；用 The moon is... 成句再得 2 分。
questions.knowledge_point: round / bright / full 描述月亮

questions.stem: Tell a friend about the moon and food.

answer.value: The moon is round. We eat mooncakes.

questions.analysis: 评分要点：用 round 或 bright 描述得 2 分；We eat... 说活动得 2 分；两句完整得 1 分。
questions.knowledge_point: round / bright / full 描述月亮

questions.stem: Which word has /m/ first?
questions.analysis: moon 以 m 开头发 /m/；zip、fan、bed 首音不同，所以选 A。
questions.knowledge_point: 字母 Mm 发 /m/ 的首音辨识

questions.stem: Give two /m/ words: ___ and ___.
questions.analysis: mouth 与 map 都以 m 开头发 /m/。
questions.knowledge_point: 字母 Mm 发 /m/ 的首音辨识

questions.stem: The letter m in 'mango' says /m/.
questions.analysis: mango 词首 m 发 /m/，判断正确，所以对。
questions.knowledge_point: 字母 Mm 发 /m/ 的首音辨识

questions.stem: List two /m/ words, please.
questions.analysis: 评分要点：两个 /m/ 首音词各得 2 分；拼写正确再得 1 分。
questions.knowledge_point: 字母 Mm 发 /m/ 的首音辨识
